name: Unavoidable Strike [Psionic]
body:
You can make an unarmed strike or use a natural weapon against your foe as if delivering a touch attack.

Prerequisite: Str 13, Psionic Fist, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus as part of either an unarmed strike or an attack with a natural weapon. You can resolve that unarmed strike or attack with a natural weapon as a touch attack. You must decide whether or not to use this feat prior to making an attack. If your attack misses, you still expend your psionic focus. Abilities that do not work on touch attacks similarly do not work with this feat.
